title: XE IPO lockup ends — X-Energy, cut short by its blackout clause from 180 days after its 2026-04-23 prospectus
source: SEC: 8-K https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2088896/000119312526256369/xe-20260604.htm (filed 2026-06-04, Item 7.01 "Expected Early Lock-Up Release Date"), fetched 2026-10-20: "The Restricted Period is scheduled to end on October 20, 2026, which falls within the Company's quarterly blackout period. Therefore, under the lock-up agreements, the Restricted Period will end on September 1, 2026, ten trading days prior to the commencement of such blackout period." The 424B4 https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2088896/000110465926049515/tm2527015-22_424b4.htm states 180 days with the blackout clause that allows it (#5920).
notes: $1.0B offering. Insiders may sell from the next session; the pullback the lockup-expiry playbook studies (#5912) is the supply that unlocks then. Filed first as 2026-10-20 (the 180-day date) because discovery did not read the blackout clause; corrected from the issuer's 8-K.
